claim_scores.rationale: Uses `dspy.ChatAdapter().format(...)` to build and inspect `messages` offline, with no LM invocation.
Includes an incomplete demo with one input (`passage`) and one output (`answer`), matching the retained-incomplete case.
Asserts the partial demo user message contains the incomplete-demo prefix about fields not being supplied.
Asserts the partial demo assistant message contains `Not supplied for this particular example.` for the missing output field.
Also checks the complete demo appears later with its real values (`Another passage.` and `line 1`).
